# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P4](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is a fat girl. She wears dresses with flounces and sleeve puffs.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c31 P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)_

## Personality

Josie is considered a cheat, sulky, and malicious, with a reputation for being the sharpest-tongued young lady at Queen's. She exhibits a triumphant, defiant, and taunting attitude toward others, especially when challenging them or gloating over her own achievements. Deficient in popular qualities, she frequently makes snide or unkind remarks about her peers and takes delight in their discomfiture.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c33 P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033)_

## History

Josie Pye attended Avonlea school under Mr. Phillips and later Miss Stacy. During a school spelling exercise, she cheated by peeking in her book, which Anne Shirley observed. At a school party, Josie successfully walked a board fence and subsequently dared Anne to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, leading to Anne's fall and broken ankle. She participated in the school concert preparations, although she was sulky about not being cast as the Fairy Queen. Josie joined the Queen's class, passed the Entrance examinations, and attended Queen's Academy, where she gained a reputation as the sharpest-tongued student. After passing her First Class License exams, she decided to return to Queen's for another year rather than teach.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P30](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0030), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)_
